Fareyi ekranın üst ortasındaki siyah çen: Move the mouse to the black notch at the top center of the screen and the island opens. Move away and it closes on its own; I never get in front of any window.
When open, the home page has colorful chips. Each one is a section; click to go in. Use the small icons at the top to switch to home, chat, search and settings.
Bir dosyayı sürükleyip üstüme bırak, yut: Drag a file and drop it on me — I swallow it and keep it on the Shelf. Later, drag it from the shelf to wherever you like. Screenshots you take land on the shelf on their own, too.

Sohbet, ekrana sor ve sesli komut için G: Chat, ask-the-screen and voice commands need Google's free Gemini key. Paste it once and I'll set alarms, take notes, control music and remember things.
Uzun süre ekrana bakınca göz molası, ara: When you stare at the screen for long I remind you to rest your eyes, and to drink water now and then. These always work, even without focus mode. I keep quiet in games and full screen.
İlgilendikçe mutlu olurum, uzun süre unu: The more you care, the happier I get; forget me for long and I sulk. You can grab and fling me, or poke me. Try it now: grab me on the left and fling!
Bana bir isim ver; bulut, kalp, damla gi: Give me a name; pick a body like cloud, heart or drop, a vinyl or plush texture and a color. I can wear glasses, a cap, bunny ears, a sprout or a flower clip too. Hover over us to meet; change it anytime from Right-click › Look.
Argus, izlediğin dizi ve filmlerin arşiv: Argus is the archive of the shows and movies you watch; we're one family. I handle your next episode, new releases and "what should I watch?", and when you say "Watched" I log it in Argus.
Argus, izlediğin dizi ve filmleri takip: Argus is the archive app where you track the shows and movies you watch; it's my sibling. If you install it, I'll tell you about new episodes, pick what to watch and mark what you've watched.

Nook'un yanındaki bilgiler düzenli küçük: The info next to Nook became tidy little cards: a colored icon, details on the second line (artist, how many minutes until, weather), the time or a percentage on the right, and a progress bar for songs and Pomodoro.
Müzik çalarken Medya, Pomodoro sürerken: While music plays, the Media chip, and during Pomodoro the Pomodoro chip, slowly breathe in their own color; empty ones (Shelf, Note…) stay faded. The Nooks on the chips move too: they blink now and then and hop when an alarm is near.
Çiplerin sonundaki Düzenle'ye bas: çipi: Press Edit at the end of the chips: grab a chip and drag it where you like, hide the ones you don't use with the eye icon. Settings has section tabs at the top, and buttons like Clear are outlined.
Nook ara sıra adadan atlayıp önündeki pe: Now and then Nook hops off the island and sits on the title bar of the window in front. As you move the window it wobbles to keep its balance, and hops over when you switch windows. Hover over the island and it comes right back.
Uzun süre ekranın alt kısmında çalışırke: When you work at the bottom of the screen for a long time, Nook dangles from the island on a tiny rope and watches you. Move the mouse close and it quickly reels up and escapes into the island.
Bilgisayar boştayken Nook adanın kenarın: While the computer is idle, Nook sits on the edge of the island and casts a line onto the desktop. Sometimes it pulls up an old junk file, sometimes a shiny star; when you're back it tells you what it caught.
When Pomodoro starts, Nook moves to its desk. If you open a site like YouTube or X while working, it knocks on the glass and shows the clock: "Weren't we working?" Change the sites in Settings › Focus guard.
Bir .zip ya da .rar dosyasını adanın üst: Drop a .zip or .rar file on the island: its contents are listed and you can browse folders. Grab any file and drag it to the desktop, a folder or Discord; double-click to open.
Odaya biri girdi mi? Ctrl+Alt+H'ye bas:: Someone walked in? Press Ctrl+Alt+H: sleeping Nooks cover every screen. Press again, Esc or double-click to bring things back. Change the shortcut in Settings.
Panoya kart numarası, IBAN, API anahtarı: When a card number, IBAN, API key or password is copied, Nook warns you with a lock, keeps it out of clipboard history and clears it from the clipboard after 60 seconds. Everything happens on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
Ana sayfadaki her çipin Nook'u artık işi: Each chip's Nook on the home page now dresses for its job: headphones on Media, a sprouting tomato on Pomodoro, a monocle on Report card…
Köstebek, Eşleştir ve Zıpla. Oyun bölümü: Whack-a-Nook, Match and Jump. The Games section now has five games, each with its own record.

Günün özetindeki kartlara dokununca ilgi: Tapping cards in the daily brief opens the related section: alarms, report card, notifications, shows. The Report card now also shows how the grade is calculated.

Claude Code'u adadan yönet: Run Claude Code from the island
Ana sayfadaki Claude çipinden Claude Cod: Connect Claude Code once from the Claude chip on the home page and watch live what your sessions are doing in each project (commands, file edits). If it needs permission while you're in another window, the island shows a card: Allow, Always, Deny or answer in the terminal. If it asks a question, the options appear on the island, and the island tells you when the work is done. If Claude Code isn't on your computer, the chip stays hidden.
5 saatlik ve haftalık Claude limitinin n: How full your 5-hour and weekly Claude limits are and when they reset shows up in the Claude section (Pro and Max). The island warns you once at 80% and once when it's full.
İzleme süresi tam ekranda da doğru: Watch time is right in full screen too
Video tam ekrandayken Nook izlediğin sür: While a video was in full screen, Nook undercounted your watch time (26 min watched showed as 5 min). Now the real elapsed time is counted, so the "done?" question arrives on time after 15 min.
Karne artık büyük adada açılır. Harf not: The report card now opens on the big island. Next to your letter grade it shows which score earns which letter, how the grade was built up piece by piece and where the easiest points are. Focus time stands out in the daily chart; screen time, focus, Pomodoro, water, music, games and caring for Nook are compared with last week.
Şarkı sözleri, yayın maskesi, yıl özeti: Lyrics, stream mask, year in review
Medya'da \"Sözler\"e bas: çalan şarkının: Press "Lyrics" in Media: the lyrics of the playing song scroll along with the music and the current line lights up. If they're early or late, shift them by ±0.5 s. The current line also shows under the song on the open island. Lyrics come from lrclib.net.
Teams, Zoom, Meet ya da tarayıcıdan ekra: When you share your screen from Teams, Zoom, Meet or a browser, or while OBS is open, Nook grabs a mic and turns on the LIVE sign; Note, Clipboard, Notifications, Chat and Calendar get frosted and notification cards hide their content. Ctrl+Alt+L turns it on / off manually.
Ana sayfadaki Yıl özeti: birlikte geçen: Year in review on the home page: hours spent together, the hour you were here most, your most-played artists, Pomodoro rounds, games you played, water you drank. It shows up by itself at the end of December; recording starts today.
Ses kartı adayla gider: The sound card goes with the island
Ada taşınınca yanındaki ses kartı da gel: When the island moves, the sound card next to it follows; if there's no room on the left of the screen, it moves to the island's right. Pick the output from the list and see each app's volume. Open / close the card with the speaker in the top bar; on the big island, sound settings sit under Nook.
Ana sayfada profil şeridindeki + ile yen: Add a new profile with + in the profile strip on the home page and pick which sections it includes with the eye icon; rename it or delete it.
Arama, sabitleme, görsel ve dosya geçmiş: Search, pinning, image and file history, opening and editing an entry. Ctrl+Alt+V pastes plain text; the clipboard can be cleared when the screen locks or after a few minutes; copies from password managers are never saved. Colors copy as HEX, RGB or HSL.
En fazla 8 not, kendiliğinden kaydedilir: Up to 8 notes, saved automatically; double-click to rename. Formatted preview with headings, bold, lists and checkboxes, and saving to a file.
Bir dosyayı sürüklerken fareyi sağa sola: Shake the mouse left and right while dragging a file to open the shelf. Ctrl+Alt+S adds the files selected in Explorer to the shelf. Pinned items never fall off the shelf; there's also "Open together".
Kontrol › Uygulama sesi: oyun hoparlörde: Controls › App volume: the game on the speakers, Discord on the headset; pick the output and mic there, and pin or hide apps. The volume can drop when headphones are unplugged, and a shortcut cycles through outputs.
Ayarlar › Takvim'e takviminin gizli iCal: Add your calendar's secret iCal address in Settings › Calendar: events show up in Calendar and you get a heads-up as they get close. A countdown on the closed island an hour before a meeting; a stopwatch in Focus.
Ekran kartı kullanımı, bütün diskler ve: Graphics card usage, every disk and its health, safely ejecting USB drives, local IP, session traffic and a speed test. Nook warns you if the CPU or memory stays busy for a long time or a disk fills up.
Sahneni seç, kalkandan sesi yönet: Pick your scene, control sound from the shield
Ayarlar › Gizlilik kalkanı: sahneler kar: Settings › Privacy shield: scenes can shuffle, go in order or always be the same; in shuffle and in-order modes, choose which scenes appear.
Kalkandan mikrofon ve ses: Mic and sound from the shield
Sağ üstteki mikrofon ve hoparlöre tıklay: Click the mic and speaker at the top right to turn them off / on (when locked, it asks for the password first). Choose in Settings whether the mic and call audio turn off when the shield goes up.
Teams'te mikrofon kapalı kalmıyor: Teams mic no longer stays muted
Görüşmedeyken kalkan mikrofonu susturmak: In a call, the shield lowers the mic level to zero instead of muting it; Teams doesn't flip its own button, and the mic returns to its previous level when the shield lifts.
Nook'lar göz kırpar, etrafa bakınır, zıp: Nooks blink, look around and crouch and spring when they jump. Characters no longer transform every few seconds but on an event in the scene: when a potion spills, an experiment blows up, the lights go out…
Kovboy, korsan, hasır şapka, kondüktör k: Cowboy, pirate, straw hat, conductor cap, helmet, hard hat, goggles, eye patch and scarf: pick them in Look, and they wear them in the scenes too.
Atari salonu, deniz altı, sera, gece tre: Arcade, under the sea, greenhouse, night train, cinema, Wild West, pirate ship, mad lab, lavender field, bunker, Ferris wheel and sketchbook. Each has its own clock: a scoreboard, a brass porthole, a misty window, a train ticket, Nixie tubes, a ticket tied to a balloon…

Kalkanda sağ tıklayınca tarayıcı menüsü: Right-clicking the shield shows only Reload instead of the browser menu; a new scene comes in.
Mikrofon daha güvenilir geri açılır: The mic comes back on more reliably
Kalkan birden fazla mikrofonu kapatır ve: The shield mutes more than one mic and, when it lifts, unmutes only the ones it muted; even if the shield goes right back up, the mic isn't forgotten.
Her sahnenin kendi saati: Every scene has its own clock
Saat artık sahnenin bir parçası: kampta: The clock is now part of the scene: a wooden sign at the camp, a chalkboard at the café, neon at the disco, a screen in space, a banner pulled by a plane at the beach, a scroll in the library… It never gets in front of anything.
Sahnedeki Nook'lar değişir: The Nooks in the scene change
Roller aynı, oyuncular değişir: her Nook: Same roles, new actors: every few seconds each Nook turns into another body, color and texture in a little puff of dust.
Görüşmede karşı tarafın sesi de kapanır: In calls, the other side's audio mutes too
Kalkan açılınca mikrofonu kullanan uygul: When the shield goes up, the app using the mic (Discord, Teams, Zoom…) is muted, and it's unmuted when the shield lifts. The badge in the corner is now just an icon.
